key_terms.الْمَفْتُونُ: The distracted one; one who is bewitched or heedless of God

ai.seo_question: What does it mean to be 'maftoon' (distracted) in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this phrase is often interpreted as a divine challenge to the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) and the believers to identify who among them has lost their spiritual sanity due to attachment to worldly desires. It underscores the concept of 'ghaflah' (heedlessness), warning that true madness lies not in ritual practice but in the neglect of divine consciousness amidst the distractions of the material world.
